# Ron's Mandarin

> Free Taiwan Mandarin study app for the *Modern Chinese* (時代華語) textbook series, built for adult learners (18+) including Shu-Te University students.

Ron's Mandarin helps learners study *Modern Chinese* (時代華語) lesson by lesson with Traditional Chinese characters, Taiwan pronunciation audio, read-along dialogues and readings, interactive grammar lessons and book exercises, FSRS spaced-repetition flashcards, character decomposition memory hooks, stroke-order writing practice, TOCFL mock tests, and Study Together quiz races.

## Core Facts

- **Canonical URL:** https://ronsmandarin.com/
- **Price:** Free (no ads, no paid plan)
- **Script & Pronunciation:** Traditional Chinese characters with Taiwan Mandarin pronunciation (notes mainland pronunciation differences where relevant)
- **Curriculum Alignment:** Follows the *Modern Chinese* (時代華語) textbooks (Books 1 to 3 open in beta) and Taiwan's TBCL / TOCFL proficiency framework
- **Access:** Open to anyone 18 or older with a Google account; full lesson packs and audio require sign-in
- **Independence:** Independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tamkang University's Chinese Language Center or Cheng Chung Book Co.

## Public Pages

- [Home & Interactive Demos](https://ronsmandarin.com/): App overview, live sample flashcards, grammar patterns, character memory hooks, lesson syllabus preview, and FAQ
- [Books & Lesson Syllabus](https://ronsmandarin.com/books): Lesson-by-lesson syllabus for *Modern Chinese* (時代華語) plus read-along audio and character memory hooks
- [Lesson pages](https://ronsmandarin.com/books/1/lesson-1): One page per lesson of Books 1 to 3 (`/books/1/lesson-1` to `/books/3/lesson-16`) with sample words and Taiwan audio, a short original conversation, and the lesson's grammar points
- [Grammar & Book Exercises](https://ronsmandarin.com/grammar): Grammar explanations, interactive sentence-building patterns, and textbook exercise practice
- [TOCFL Prep & Mock Tests](https://ronsmandarin.com/tocfl): Listening and reading mock tests aligned with *Modern Chinese* (時代華語) and TOCFL bands
- [About](https://ronsmandarin.com/about): Who builds Ron's Mandarin, teaching philosophy, and data privacy
- [Sources & Licenses](https://ronsmandarin.com/sources): Attributions for CC-CEDICT, TBCL/TOCFL benchmarks, CJKVI/Make Me a Hanzi decomposition, fonts, and audio
- [Privacy Policy](https://ronsmandarin.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://ronsmandarin.com/terms)
